chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari, who said:

I was with Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) in the ship on the Tigris. The time for prayer arrived, so I said, 'May I be your ransom, should we pray in congregation?' He said, 'Do not pray a congregation prayer in the belly of a valley.'

key_terms.بَطْنِ وَادٍ: Belly of a valley (or body of the vessel)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying congregational prayer inside a ship or boat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) addresses the practical jurisprudence of performing congregational prayer aboard a vessel in the Tigris River. The Imam’s instruction to avoid praying the congregation 'in the belly of a valley' (or the ship's hold) highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on spatial adequacy and stability for communal worship, distinguishing it from individual prayer in confined or unstable spaces. This ruling underscores the importance of maintaining the dignity and order of the *jama'ah* even in transient environments.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Abu Hashim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I was with Abu Al-Hassanasws regarding the ship in (River) Dijlat, and the Salāt presented itself. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! We should pray in a Jam’at’. So heasws said: ‘You cannot pray a Jam’atal Salāt in the belly (bottom) of a valley’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from abu Hashim al-Ja‘fariy who has said the following:

“One abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and I were in a ship on the Tigris. It became time for Salah (prayer) and I said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, can we perform Salah (prayer) in congregation? He (the Imam) said, ‘No, we perform Salah (prayer) in the valley in congregation.’”
